mapper.select: SELECT menu_id AS menuId, menu_name AS menuName, menu_price AS menuPrice, menu_image AS menuImage, deleted, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, to_char(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt FROM menu_read WHERE deleted = FALSE ORDER BY menu_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_read ( menu_id, menu_name, menu_price, menu_image, deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{menuId}, #{menuName}, #{menuPrice}, #{menuImage}, FALSE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (menu_id) DO UPDATE SET menu_name = EXCLUDED.menu_name, menu_price = EXCLUDED.menu_price, menu_image = EXCLUDED.menu_image, deleted = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE menu_read SET deleted = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
UPDATE menu_read SET deleted = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE deleted = FALSE
